results.question: Which towns in Swabia are regional centres (Oberzentren)?
results.answer:
The regional centres (Oberzentren) in Swabia are:

- Augsburg
- Dillingen a.d.Donau/Lauingen (Donau)
- Donauwörth
- Günzburg/Leipheim
- Kaufbeuren
- Kempten (Allgäu)
- Lindau (Bodensee) (/Bregenz)
- Memmingen
- (Ulm/)Neu-Ulm
- Nördlingen
- Sonthofen/Immenstadt i.Allgäu

Source: [LEP_Anhang_1_Zentrale_Orte_2018.pdf, p. 3–4](LEP_Anhang_1_Zentrale_Orte_2018.pdf, p. 3–4)

results.question: Is Munich an Oberzentrum according to the Bavarian plan?
results.answer: Yes, Munich is an Oberzentrum according to the Bavarian plan. It is listed as one of the Oberzentren in the Oberbayern region (file LEP_Anhang_1_Zentrale_Orte_2018.pdf, p. 3).
